CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates how actively this partner engages with us, per Partnerships' color criteria: Red: Cold prospect. No interactions or engagement have occurred, or past engagement has ceased. Yellow: Communicated at some point. Has expressed interest in partnership, or we're waiting to reach back out. Blue: Communicating with us regularly, based on need. Engaged with us in a specific, defined way. Green: Consistently communicating with us. Engaged with us in multiple ways.
CustomField.label: Partnership Engagement Status
